testChange.reason: The create-worktree toolbar control gained a second gate — repository availability, beside the body gate — because the applied requirement "A row is never offered an action it cannot perform" names the toolbar and requires absent rather than inert. Two existing tests exercised the body gate alone and now open the availability gate first, so they keep testing what they were written to test.
